description: This file defines the interface MerchantConfigurationDao, which extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for accessing merchant configuration data linked to stores and configuration types.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending a generic DAO for MerchantConfiguration entities, providing methods to query configurations based on keys, store, and type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the MerchantConfiguration associated with a given key and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of merchant configurations associated with the specified store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by configuration type and store.
